name: St Regis Residence Club, Aspen
insider_take: Where alpine luxury meets fractional ownership perfection – this exclusive residence club sits at the base of Aspen Mountain with direct ski-in access.
whats_special: The St. Regis Residence Club offers fully-owned luxury condominiums with hotel services, featuring ski-in/ski-out access to Aspen Mountain's legendary slopes. Each residence includes a private ski locker and access to the exclusive Owner's Lounge. The property's prime location puts you steps from the Silver Queen Gondola and Aspen's vibrant downtown scene.
pro_tip: Book during Aspen's shoulder seasons (late spring/early fall) for better rates while still enjoying world-class dining, shopping, and hiking with fewer crowds on the mountain.
dont_miss: The legendary après-ski scene at nearby Cloud Nine Alpine Bistro, accessible only by gondola mid-mountain. Also explore the historic Wheeler Opera House and browse Aspen's high-end boutiques along Cooper Avenue – all within walking distance of your residence.
pros: Luxurious residence-style accommodations with spacious layouts
Prime Aspen location with ski-in/ski-out access
Signature St. Regis butler service and amenities
Full kitchen and home-like conveniences for extended stays
cons: Premium pricing reflects exclusive Aspen market
Seasonal availability may be limited during peak periods
